## About
Bob's Premier Automotive Repair is a full-service repair and preventive maintenance shop in Richland Hills. We work on domestic and import cars and trucks of all makes and models, from air conditioning and electrical problems to brakes, alignments, engines and transmissions.
Before we touch anything, you get an estimate that is easy to understand, and we can talk through ways to keep costs down. Most maintenance can be done while you wait, and we stand behind our work with a guarantee.
Neighbors have given us a 4.5 rating across 42 Google reviews. One longtime customer wrote that David always takes the time to make sure he understands what's going on with his vehicles, and that Steve in the office is always friendly.

## Services
- Air conditioning: If your AC isn't keeping the car or truck cab cool, our trained technicians can find the problem and fix it.
- Engine & transmission: Engine and transmission work to keep your vehicle running the way it should.
- Alignments: Wheel alignment to help your vehicle drive straight and keep your tires wearing evenly.
- Electrical system: Checking your electrical system and tracking down symptoms before they turn into bigger issues.
- Brakes: Brake inspection and repair for the most important safety system on your car.
- Preventative maintenance: Staying on your vehicle's maintenance schedule to head off long-term, costly problems.
- AWD service: Service for all-wheel-drive systems.

## FAQ
Q: How quickly can you finish a repair?
A: Many repairs, such as AC, brakes and transmission work, are performed that day.

Q: Do you work on my make of car?
A: We work on domestic and import vehicles of all makes and models, cars and trucks alike.
